image_description: Two compact audio cassettes placed side-by-side on a white surface. The left cassette has a colorful abstract label with pink and orange stripes and text 'Cassette Quality'. The right cassette has a black label with 'MP3' and 'Folks' branding and similar colorful graphics. Both have transparent plastic casings, visible internal spools, and standard mechanical features like screw holes and write-protect tabs.
